name: Nikolas
source:
Height: 5'9"
Magic: Light

Nikolas has a severe case of amnesia. The only thing he seems to remember is that he and Rune belong together.

He is cheerful and friendly, but also a bit scatterbrained. He is very clingy with Rune.
